questions.q: Find the interior angle of a regular decagon (10 sides).
The angle at the centre of a circle is 130°. Find the angle at the circumference subtended by the same arc.
questions.why: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference, so 130 ÷ 2 = 65°.

questions.q: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral with angle ABC = 74°. Find angle ADC.
questions.why: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral add up to 180°: 180 − 74 = 106°.

questions.q: PT is a tangent to a circle, centre O, touching it at T. Write down angle OTP and give a geometrical reason.
questions.model: 90°; the tangent is perpendicular to the radius (at the point of contact)
